floor_history.headline: Recon: stale 119 migration pin killed — honest floor is 57/173 (insn-count already exact); residual is one OR-association copy + the count-1 comparand carrier, both pass-attributed from the .loop dump

Floor 57 -> 52 in pure ordinary C: declaring `complement` inside the inner loop spends loop.c's first move (threshold -= 3) so the `count - 1` comparand stays inline, which retires s1's variable-reuse

frontier.hypothesis: The OR-chain constant absorption is decided in the TREE (fold-const.c) before RTL, so no remaining C-level regrouping of the same three terms can move `-0x8000` onto the green term; the fix, if one exists, has to change which term heads the chain at tree level or change what the green term IS.
frontier.mechanism: fold-const.c reassociates a constant operand outwards through associative `|`; seven spellings (K7) all produced `li v0,-32768` + `or <red>,<red>,v0` first, so the parenthesised grouping never survives to RTL.
frontier.next_probe: With y1 applied, read the `;; Function func_8003DE14` section of tmp/grind/func_8003DE14/dumps/code6cac_c2.rtl first, then .cse and .combine, and find the insn that first materialises `(ior (reg) (const_int -32768))`. If the grouping is already wrong in .rtl the tree came out of fold reassociated (tree-shape fix needed, or the term is not what we think it is); if .combine re-sinks it, the lever is a combine-visible one. One read decides whether any spelling is left.

frontier.hypothesis: The swapped src/dst (a2/a3) and j/complement (t4/t5) pairs are a single allocno-ordering decision, and declaration order is measured inert (K4 three times, K8), so the residual is a typed RA question rather than a C-spelling question.
frontier.mechanism: GCC 2.7.2 global.c/local-alloc allocno priority ordering hands the lower-numbered caller-save to the wrong member of each pair; the two pairs show the identical relation, suggesting one ordering comparison decides both.
frontier.next_probe: Run tools/ra_solver/inverse_compose.py classify on the .greg/.lreg allocation for the src, dst, j and complement pseudos (pseudo numbers are in tmp/grind/func_8003DE14/dumps/code6cac_c2.lreg) for a REACHABLE / FORECLOSED verdict plus ranked C-lever vectors, instead of guessing more declaration permutations.

frontier.hypothesis: The blend-arm ordering residual (the `andi 0x7C00` after the final `or` chain in the build vs before it in the target, and a one-slot `mflo`/`srl` interleave difference on the blue channel) is a scheduler-order item, not an allocation one.
frontier.mechanism: sched.c list-scheduling priority within the blend basic block; the instruction count already matches exactly, so only emission order differs.
frontier.next_probe: tools/sched_solver on the blend arm's basic block for an order-exact verdict; in parallel, measure a statement re-association that computes the masked blue term into its own named local before the final OR of `*dst = (pixel & 0x8000) | r_ch | g_ch | (b_shift & 0x7C00);`.
